name: EPIC 201772350
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 13.9 solar radii and 1.23 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201772350 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.925976 (16th-84th percentiles 13.391395-14.432675), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201772350 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.23376 (16th-84th percentiles 1.121352-1.342417), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201772350: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4846.3047 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201772350 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 7231.015625 (16th-84th percentiles 7044.765625-7414.84375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.09 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 7,231 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.23 solar masses and 13.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,846 K at its surface.
